transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer accounts and billing, my name is Chloe. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Chloe, my name is Marcus Fletcher. I renewed my broadband contract last month with an agreed loyalty tariff of thirty-five pounds per month, but my October bank statement arrived today and S-Net have charged me fifty pounds, omitting the fifteen-pound monthly loyalty discount completely!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Marcus. I can look into your contract schedule and correct that invoice for you. Before we inspect your billing ledger, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 19 Castle View, Durham, DH1 3NW, security PIN 2841, account reference SN-550182.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus, that confirms your account details. What specific contract date did you complete the renewal agreement on?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It was agreed on September 14th with an agent named David in your retentions department.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query your promotional billing contract schedule and retentions call log?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Marcus. I have reviewed the retentions order from September 14th, and I can see the fifteen-pound loyalty discount promo code LOYAL-15 was generated but failed to attach to the recurring direct debit schedule.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why did the discount code fail to attach to my direct debit?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The order management system encountered an API timeout with the automated banking billing scheduler during the overnight batch run.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So S-Net took an extra fifteen pounds from my Santander account purely because of a computer glitch?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that is correct, and I will manually attach the discount promotion and issue an immediate refund for the fifteen-pound overcharge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How quickly will that fifteen pounds be refunded back to my bank account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can apply an immediate fifteen-pound credit to your S-Net account balance, or process an electronic refund directly to your Santander bank card within three working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please process the refund directly to my bank card; I don't want it sitting as bill credit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have submitted an electronic card refund of fifteen pounds via our Bacs gateway, reference REF-88192-M.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: REF-88192-M, noted down. And what about next month's bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am manually appending promotional discount code LOYAL-15 directly to your monthly recurring billing schedule.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will that guarantee that every future invoice for the next seventeen months shows thirty-five pounds?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously billing systems process standard tariff rates unless a verified promotion code is formally attached to the billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, and now that it is attached, it should stay at thirty-five pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I specifically agreed to renew my contract for eighteen months because your retentions agent promised in writing that my bill would stay at thirty-five pounds! Seeing fifty pounds taken from my bank account makes me feel completely lied to and cheated! I am sick and tired of having to fight telecom companies over false promises!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your frustration and disappointment at seeing a higher amount deducted after being promised a specific renewal rate, Marcus. You should never have to fight for agreed terms, and I will correct your monthly discount and credit the overcharge right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Chloe, I appreciate you understanding why that was so upsetting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have locked the recurring thirty-five-pound charge into your account profile, valid through March 2026.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you email me a formal revised contract confirmation displaying thirty-five pounds?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am generating an updated PDF contract summary and emailing it to your registered address right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking email on my phone... Yes, the PDF arrived: 'Contract Renewal Summary - Monthly Tariff £35.00'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The document also confirms your fifteen-pound card refund reference on page two.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Page two confirms the fifteen-pound refund to card ending 4401. That is wonderful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also added a persistent note to your billing ledger preventing any automated rate adjustments.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me great peace of mind for the rest of my contract term.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your direct debit for November 1st will automatically collect exactly thirty-five pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And the fifteen-pound refund should arrive in my Santander account by Friday?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, banking clearing cycles take between two and three working days, so Friday at the latest.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Perfect. Everything is completely transparent and documented.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also waived the five-pound paper billing fee that was erroneously added to your profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is an extra five pounds saved.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our priority is ensuring that promotional agreements made during contract renewal are honored precisely.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have handled this with fantastic efficiency, Chloe.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus, I am glad we could resolve the billing discrepancy swiftly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is refreshing when customer service actually fixes the mistake on the first call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just before I apply the account credit, what was your customer account reference number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I mentioned earlier, it is SN-550182.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus, that closes out our formal billing ledger reconciliation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything looks completely sorted on my end.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will also receive an SMS confirmation containing your refund tracking number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Just received the text message: 'S-Net Refund £15.00 processed successfully'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your billing account I can assist you with today, Marcus?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Chloe, you have resolved everything perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer accounts and billing, Marcus. Have a wonderful day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Chloe.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
